set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: O01.2
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend/operations engineer
Scope: Supply a minimal supported deployment profile for staging and later pilot operation.

Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: O01 (bd-01M4W40K19EDEPHZA7Y20F340Z)
Suggested delivery tranche: T1; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Validate database/storage/port/proxy/secret settings before serving; omit secrets from errors and ordinary process diagnostics.
2. Provide loopback/proxy or equivalent protected-origin configuration, TLS termination guidance, filesystem ownership and process supervision.
3. Graceful shutdown stops new work, drains or safely checkpoints bounded in-flight work and leaves leases recoverable after forced termination.
4. Validate storage-root ownership/path isolation and redaction of JDBC URLs, proxy headers and exception causes; test missing/read-only roots, unsafe origins and port collisions with credential canaries.

Verification: Clean-host configuration matrix and terminate/restart smoke tests under the deployment profile.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O01.2/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

Source/contracts:
- modules/service/src/main/scala/sanctity/app/ApiServer.scala
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresDatabase.scala
- build.sbt
- docs/service-distribution.md
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- O01.1: bd-01M4W5P7HBS1087HA1EX9MC0P2

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: O01.2: Validate deployment configuration and protected service startup
